Zenith Tokens

Open models, one API. Priced to be used.

Zenith Tokens is our inference platform: one OpenAI-compatible gateway to DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi and Qwen, served on the stack we research and measure. Open models start at $0.10 per million input tokens.

How it works

Three steps to production.

  1. 01

    Create a key

    Sign up, then create an API key in the console. Set quotas and permissions per key.

  2. 02

    Connect

    Use the OpenAI-compatible endpoint from your SDK, agent framework or desktop client.

  3. 03

    Monitor

    Track tokens, cost and latency per key and per model in real time.

curl · OpenAI-compatible
curl https://tokens.aitist.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZENITH_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello, Zenith"}]
  }'

Platform

The parts you would otherwise build.

Unified API

One protocol, many models.

OpenAI-compatible chat routes, with Claude, Gemini and Responses-style routes supported by the gateway.

Routing

Load balancing.

Requests are spread across upstream channels with automatic failover.

Control

Rate limits & quotas.

Set limits per key so one runaway agent cannot drain a team budget.

Billing

Pay as you go.

Token-based pricing with real-time usage and cost tracking.

Teams

Shared access.

Multi-user management with flexible permissions.

Transparency

Live status & rankings.

Per-model availability, latency and usage rankings are public on the platform.

The engineering underneath

We publish the measurements.

Cheaper tokens come from better systems. Each number links to the note that explains how it was measured.

40.6 → 5.9µs one-row all-reduce on PCIe GPUs 1,045,368input tokens in a measured retrieval run 1,991output tok/s, Kimi-K3 on 16 B200 GPUs 97 → 0empty-argument failures, 1,600 forced calls

Research measurements under the conditions described in each note. They show how we engineer the stack. They are not platform service levels.
